fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $127,000 (comprised of: $50,000 initial license fee, $70,600 training/supply/support fee, $3,350 Turf Tamer Stand-On Applicator Lease deposit, $3,050 Turf Tamer Power Seeder Lease deposit). In states where agronomic conditions are not conducive to seeding, the fee is reduced to $123,950. VetFran/MinorityFran/Green Fran/First Responder candidates receive a 10% reduction on the $50,000 license fee portion (discounts cannot be combined). Existing franchisees adding a second location pay a reduced fee of $25,000. Qualified employees of Strategic-Partners with 5+ years in the system receive a $10,000 reduction. Actual fees received during 2024 fiscal year ranged from $114,450 to $122,000.
raw_excerpt: You must pay LDI this nonrefundable initial franchise fee of $127,000 in full when you sign the Franchise Agreement and related leases. In certain states where agronomic conditions are not conducive to a seeding program (as determined by LDI), the Turf Tamer Power Seeder is removed from the initial franchise package, and the initial franchise fee is reduced to $123,950. ... If you sign such a franchise agreement, you will pay an initial franchise fee of $25,000 that entitles you to operate the Lawn Doctor Business using the Marks in the Territory granted under the new agreement. ... The initial franchise fees LDI received during its 2024 fiscal year ranged from $114,450 to $122,000.
